Record Class RebalancingPlan.Line

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.algo.RebalancingPlan.Line
Record Components:
levelType - discriminator letter of the hierarchy: T, A or S
idNode - the AlgoTop, AlgoAssetclass or AlgoSecurity this line describes
idParentNode - the bucket a security line hangs below, null on the other two levels
idSecuritycurrency - the instrument of a security line, null on the other two levels
label - what the report names the node, already in the user's language
tactical - the node is reached only by an entry strategy, so its target is a ceiling rather than something a rebalancing may fill
targetPercentage - target share of net equity in percentage points
actualPercentage - actual share of net equity in percentage points, measured as gross exposure
deviation - actual minus target, in percentage points
targetAmount - target exposure in tenant currency
actualAmount - actual gross exposure in tenant currency
action - direction of the proposed trade, not of the exposure
recommendedAmount - size of the proposed trade in tenant currency, null when nothing is proposed
recommendedUnits - size of the proposed trade in units, null when the instrument cannot be priced
rationale - why the line reads as it does; also the text of the notification
parentDeviation - deviation in percentage points of the parent target budget, when applicable
exposureChange - signed selected exposure adjustment; independent of the long/short trade direction
Enclosing class:
RebalancingPlan
